What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script serves as a powerful tool for automating digital commerce workflows, particularly for creators in markets with limited access to conventional payment processors. By leveraging Google Apps Script within a sovereign stack, creators can automate order fulfillment, ensuring that buyers receive their digital products immediately after payment confirmation. This matter significantly improves customer satisfaction and reduces the manual effort required to manage sales, making it essential for anyone engaged in digital commerce.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture consists of several interconnected components designed to work seamlessly together. When a customer makes a purchase, the NOWPayments webhook instantly notifies Google Apps Script of the payment confirmation. The script then accesses Supabase or Google Sheets to retrieve order details, generates a personalized download link, and sends it to the customer via email. This entire process can occur in under 30 seconds, showcasing the efficiency of the setup. The use of Cloudflare Workers allows for handling up to 100,000 webhook events daily at no cost, ensuring scalability and reliability.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This automated digital commerce solution is specifically built for digital creators in regions facing financial isolation or platform restrictions. Individuals selling ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital products can benefit immensely from this stack. By leveraging tools like Google Apps Script, these creators can maintain full control over their transactions, ensuring that they are not dependent on any third-party platforms that may restrict their access or charge exorbitant fees. This sovereign approach empowers creators to build sustainable businesses without barriers.
Automate your digital sales with complete control over the process.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components of this architecture include Google Apps Script for automation, NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and email services like Resend or Gmail for delivery. Each component plays a vital role in the automation pipeline: Google Apps Script serves as the logic engine, NOWPayments handles payment verification, and Supabase or Google Sheets stores and manages order data. Together, these tools create a cohesive and efficient workflow that ensures reliable delivery of digital products.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this architecture, start by purchasing the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) from https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Once you have your stack, configure your NOWPayments account and set up Google Apps Script to handle webhook notifications. Next, integrate Supabase or Google Sheets to store order data. Finally, configure your email service to send delivery links automatically upon payment confirmation. This structured approach ensures you get a fully functional automated solution in under 48 hours.
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital product delivery works by integrating payment confirmation with a delivery mechanism. When a payment is confirmed through NOWPayments, a webhook notifies Google Apps Script, which retrieves order details and sends an email with the download link to the customer. This automation eliminates manual fulfillment and speeds up delivery.
Process orders in under 30 seconds using efficient webhook architecture.

By utilizing Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments, you can build a reliable ecommerce infrastructure that ensures seamless transactions and product delivery.
Your Deployment Checklist

Deploy your backend first — Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible via HTTP POST before configuring NOWPayments. Set the IPN webhook URL in your NOWPayments account settings to point to your backend endpoint. Set the IPN secret key in both NOWPayments and your backend configuration — this is the string that both sides use to verify webhook authenticity. Upload your product files to the configured delivery storage — Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive — with the paths matching your backend configuration. Complete a real mainnet transaction and check your backend logs to confirm the webhook was received, the signature was validated, the transaction was verified on-chain, the order was logged, and the delivery email was sent. Monitor the order database daily for the first week.
Frequently Asked Questions
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated delivery uses a webhook system where NOWPayments confirms the crypto payment. This triggers Google Apps Script to generate a download link and send it via email to the customer, ensuring instant access to purchased products.
What is a webhook and how does it trigger order fulfillment?

A webhook is a mechanism that allows one application to send real-time data to another. In this context, the NOWPayments webhook alerts Google Apps Script about payment confirmations, triggering the automation process for order fulfillment.
Can I automatically send download links after a crypto payment confirms?

Yes, the process is fully automated. Once a payment is confirmed through NOWPayments, a webhook initiates Google Apps Script to send a download link to the buyer's email, streamlining the delivery process.
How reliable is the Google Apps Script for order fulfillment?

Google Apps Script is highly reliable for order fulfillment when properly configured. With the integration of NOWPayments and efficient handling of webhooks, the system can process orders rapidly and accurately.
What happens if there’s a failure in the webhook pipeline?

If a webhook fails, the order details may not be processed correctly. It’s crucial to implement error handling in the Google Apps Script to log failures and attempt retries, ensuring that all orders are fulfilled appropriately.
